name: Choice Chews | 200mg Gummies | Coconut Lime
description: Creamy coconut meets zesty lime in this tropical twist on a sativa classic. Crisp, vibrant, and full of sunshine, this limited-edition gummy is a flavor escape worth savoring. A refreshing choice when you're ready to lighten the mood.
